prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: The Law Office of Stephen M. Fuerch
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer without knowing the seriousness and details of your injuries, and directory rankings or law-firm ads aren’t enough to judge who will handle your case well. A practical starting point is to speak with **two or three plaintiff-side car-accident attorneys** who regularly handle cases in Alameda County. Local options listed in the search results include **GJEL Accident Attorneys**, **Venardi Zurada**, and **The Law Office of Stephen M. Fuerch**; treat these as leads to compare, not endorsements.

In each free consultation, ask:

- Who will personally handle my case, and how many similar car-crash cases have they taken to settlement or trial?
- What is the contingency fee, and which case costs might I owe if there’s no recovery?
- What do you think the main strengths, risks, and likely next steps are?
- How often will I hear from the attorney, rather than a case manager?

Before signing, look up the specific attorney in the **[State Bar of California Attorney Search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch)** to confirm their status and review any public discipline. Read the fee agreement carefully and don’t feel pressured to sign during the first call.

Keep medical records, bills, wage-loss information, photos, and insurer communications. Don’t give the other driver’s insurer a recorded statement or sign a release before getting advice. California deadlines can be short—especially for claims involving a government vehicle or agency—so contact a lawyer promptly.
